Playwright 1.65.0 changes the Chromium disabled-feature list. Compare [the exact upstream source](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/blob/v1.65.0/packages/playwright-core/src/server/chromium/chromiumSwitches.ts) with `test/playwright/e2e/utils/gpuIntent.mjs`:

- Add `HttpsFirstBalancedModeAutoEnable`, `TcpPortRandomizationWin`, `PreconnectToSearch`.
- Remove `DialMediaRouteProvider`, `GlobalMediaControls`, `BlockOriginHeaderModificationOnRedirect`, `Translate`, `AutoDeElevate`.

The original `#19675` contract explicitly requires this failure when Playwright changes its list. Refresh the literal `PLAYWRIGHT_DISABLED_FEATURES` copy alongside this dependency update; retain the parity guard and the single combined `--disable-features` argument with Neo's `IsolateOrigins`, `site-per-process` and `TouchpadOverscrollHistoryNavigation` additions.

A standalone candidate check reproduces the old-copy mismatch and verifies the updated 16-entry copy plus those three Neo additions in both engine and presenting profiles. That is a local declaration check, not a rerun of this Playwright 1.65 CI suite. No CI rerun or formal review verdict was issued.
